approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a square classic internet meme using this exact surprised cat photo. Preserve the cat and its expression, especially both eyes, with no text covering the eyes or face. Add large bold condensed uppercase white letters with thick black outlines, centered and fully within the image margins. At the very top, exact text: "WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY". At the very bottom, exact text: "BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY". Wrap captions into two lines if needed for large legible type. Keep the top caption in the uppermost background area, above the cat's eyes, and bottom caption at the bottom over the couch/paws. No other text. Preserve photographic appearance.
